scope: Realtime content contracts, local WebRTC reference and GUI refinement

assertions: opening a live content requests no microphone or camera
two tabs exchange and decode real WebRTC video from synthetic capture devices
audio RTP bytes arrive over the peer connection
reacting and rerendering retain the same active media capture
microphone control disables actual audio tracks
screen replacement path releases synthetic display tracks on stop
cancelling navigation keeps the current call
confirming navigation ends capture before the next content
remote participant departure removes the peer without waiting for ICE timeout
broadcast viewers receive video without requesting capture devices
one publisher serves two actual local WebRTC viewers
joining during screen sharing retains both remote audio and video tracks
390px real-time content has no document horizontal overflow
mobile reaction targets are at least 44px
reduced motion removes the visible chat height transition
half chat leaves the content viewer above the chat sheet
audio calls capture no camera track
destroy ends all captured media tracks
capture permission denial shows an error and an explicit retry action

visualReview.result: Reviewed real rendered controls and synthetic video; media controls remain before video and mobile content is wider.
